newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling stable within tight ranges.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling stable within tight ranges.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling held steady against the dollar on Wednesday in tight ranges, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.93, unchanged against the dollar. Against the pound it was at a mean rate of 88.69 from 88.57.
Dealers said rates were steady with inflows from foreign investors and the agricultural sector matched by demand from the corporate sector.
"The market is settled and will remain so in the absence of any fresh factors to move the market," a dealer said.
The money market remained liquid with overnight rates quoted unchanged between 10-15 percent.
